title: Article: Can Time Be Controlled? The Spiritual Science of Time, Death & Universe- Deep Spiritual Knowledge

segments.text: The concept of Time
Today we will discuss about the concept of time scientifically
Can the time of death be controlled?
Can someone move forward or backward in time?

Can time really flow differently for different people — where someone experiences only a short moment while much more time passes somewhere else, just like the stories connected to Lord Rama’s birth in Ayodhya?
Interestingly, science also gives hints toward such possibilities.
So let’s try to understand this in a simple and scientific way.
The Dimensional Concept of Time:
Is time truly the same for everyone?
Time is considered the one thing that binds everyone equally.
It is said that whoever takes birth becomes bound by time.
Even deities are described as existing within the limits of time.
But here comes the real question:
Can time slow down or speed up depending on motion?
To understand this, let’s first look at a very simple formula:
𝑆𝑝𝑒𝑒𝑑(s)= Distance(d) /(Fractional)Time(t)
Where:
s = speed
d = distance
t = time
Now observe something interesting.
From this formula, we can understand that speed and time are inversely connected.
This means:
If speed increases, the effect of time can reduce.
If speed decreases, the experience of time becomes longer.
In simple words:
The faster something moves,
the differently it can experience time.
And this is where the mystery of time truly begins.
Understanding Time Through Euler’s Formula
What if life itself moves in circles, cycles, and dimensions?
Note:This concept explains in 2 dimensions
Now let’s look at a very mysterious and beautiful concept called Euler’s Formula.
e^iθ=cosθ+isinθ
This is Euler’s Formula written in proper mathematical form:
e^iθ → exponential form
cosθ → horizontal (real) movement
isinθ → vertical (imaginary) movement
Together, they describe circular motion, waves, vibration, and rotational movement mathematically.
This is Euler’s Formula written in proper mathematical form:
At first, this formula may look complicated,
but its idea is actually very simple.
It connects:
movement,
circles,
vibrations,
Let’s understand this with an easy example.
Imagine a Person Walking in a Circle
Returning to the same place… but not the same moment.
Imagine a person standing at one point on a circular path.
Now the person starts walking around the circle.
As he moves:
sometimes he goes upward,
sometimes sideways,
sometimes downward,
and finally comes back to the same starting point.
This creates one complete cycle.
Now here comes the interesting part—
Even though the person returns to the same position,
time has already passed.
He came back to the same place…
but not to the same moment.
And this is exactly how many things in life work.
Day turns into night and then becomes day again
Seasons repeat
Planets revolve in cycles
Waves move in repeating patterns
Even emotions and situations in life often repeat in cycles
That’s why people say:
“What goes around, comes around.”
Because life itself moves in circular patterns.
The Hidden Meaning of the Formula
Everything in the universe moves in cycles.
Euler’s Formula shows that:
rotation,
vibration,
waves,
and motion
are all deeply connected.
It explains how something can continuously move forward,
yet still return to the same point again and again.
The Same Point… But Never the Same Time
Life may move in circles, but time never stands still.
We understood from Euler’s Formula that movement can happen in a circle:
eiθ=cos⁡θ+isin⁡θe^{i\theta}=\cos\theta+i\sin\thetaeiθ=cosθ+isinθ
In simple words, this means:
something can move in a circular path and eventually return to the same angle or starting point.
But now let’s take this idea one step deeper.
What if time is also moving along with the circle?
Normally, a circle only uses:
x-axis
y-axis
These explain position and movement.
But now imagine adding one more axis:
z-axis → time
Now the motion is no longer a flat circle.
The Spiral Staircase Example
Returning to the same place… but never to the same moment.
Imagine a person walking on a spiral staircase.
From above, it looks like the person is moving in circles again and again.
But in reality:
with every round,
the person is also moving upward.
So even if the angle becomes the same again,
the position is no longer the same as before.
This is exactly how time works.
Life may bring similar moments,
similar people,
and similar experiences again and again.
But time has already moved forward.
So even if something “comes back,” it can never return in exactly the same way as before.
That is why:
seasons repeat, days repeat, emotions repeat, experiences repeat, but the exact moment never repeats again.
The Deeper Meaning Behind “What Goes Around Comes Around”
Cycles repeat… but consciousness keeps moving.
People often say:
“What goes around, comes around.”
And in many ways, life truly works in cycles.
But the deeper reality is:
even when something comes back,
you are no longer the same person experiencing it.
Time has already changed you.
So the cycle may repeat,
but the experience can never be identical again.
And this is where the idea of multidimensional movement truly begins—
a journey not just through space,
but through time, consciousness, and experience together.
The Cosmic Spiral Of Time
The universe repeats its patterns… but time never allows the same reality to return twice.
We know that the Earth revolves around the Sun.
After completing one full revolution in around 365 days, it may seem that Earth has returned to the same place again.
But in reality, it has not returned to the exact same position.
Why?
Because while Earth is revolving around the Sun:
• the Sun itself is moving,
• the Solar System is moving,
• and even the galaxy is moving through space.
So Earth may return to the same angle around the Sun,
but the entire universe has already moved forward with time.
That means:
• cycles can repeat,
• angles can repeat,
• seasons can repeat,
but the exact position and moment can never return again.
A Simple Example
Like walking inside a moving train.
Imagine you are walking in circles inside a train.
From inside the train,
it may look like you came back to the same spot again.
But from outside,
your position has completely changed because the train itself kept moving forward.
The universe works in a very similar way.
Earth revolves around the Sun,
but at the same time,
the Sun and the galaxy are also moving continuously.
So even though things appear to repeat,
the universe is always moving ahead through time.
That is why:
life may repeat in patterns, but time never truly repeats the same moment again.
The Invisible Shape Of The Universe
The planets may not be falling through space at all… they may simply be following the invisible curves of the universe itself.
Now let’s understand the universe in a very simple way.
Imagine the universe like a huge stretched cloth or a soft rubber sheet.
When you place a heavy object on that cloth, the cloth bends downward.
For example:
If you place a heavy bowling ball on a bedsheet,
the sheet sinks near the ball.
Now if you roll a small marble nearby,
the marble automatically starts moving toward the heavier object.
The universe works in a similar way.
Massive objects like the Sun bend the space around them,
and smaller objects move along those curved paths.
This bending of space is what we call gravity.
So gravity is not just an invisible pulling force —
it is the effect of space bending around massive objects.
The Force That Keeps Earth In Motion
Why does Earth keep circling the Sun endlessly instead of crashing into it or drifting away into darkness?
Earth does not fall directly into the Sun because two things happen together:
The Sun pulls Earth inward because of its huge mass.
Earth is also moving sideways at a very high speed.
Because of this balance,
Earth keeps revolving around the Sun in a circular path called an orbit.
If Earth stopped moving sideways,
it would eventually fall toward the Sun.
The Endless Movement Of The Universe
If everything in the universe is constantly moving forward… then can any moment ever truly stay the same?
The universe is continuously expanding.
Galaxies keep moving farther apart,
and space itself keeps stretching every moment.
One simple way to understand this is:
Time never stands still.
And because time is always moving forward,
the universe also keeps changing with it.
That is why:
• moments change,
• people change,
• experiences change,
• and life never remains exactly the same.
You may return to the same place,
or experience something similar again,
but the exact same moment can never come back.
Because time always keeps moving forward.
The Secret Behind Different Time Experiences
Two people may live in the same universe… yet time may quietly move differently for both.
Now imagine something very interesting.
Two people are living in the same universe:
• One person stays normally on Earth.
• Another person travels very close to the Sun at an extremely high speed and then returns.
Will both experience time in the same way?
Science says — not exactly.
Why?
Because time changes depending on:
• speed,
• gravity,
• and where you are in space.
So even though both people exist in the same universe,
their experience of time can become different.
You can imagine it like two people traveling through different paths:
• one path is smooth and straight,
• the other is curved and difficult.
Even if both start together,
their journey will not feel the same.
The same thing happens with time.
When The Flow Of Time Starts Changing
Time may not be as constant as it appears… its flow could silently change with speed and mass.
We usually think:
• one minute is same for everyone,
• one hour is same for everyone.
But modern science says something very surprising:
Time is not completely fixed.
Under extreme conditions,
time can slow down.
And two main things can affect it:
• very high speed,
• very huge mass.
The Black Hole Mystery
A place where time behaves strangely.
We already understood that massive objects bend the universe around them.
Now imagine something far more powerful than the Sun:
A Black Hole
Its mass is so huge and compressed that:
space bends deeply,
light bends,
and even time slows down near it.
That is why black holes look mysterious.
From far away, it appears as if:
things go inside,
and never return.
Because near such huge mass,
time behaves very differently.
A Simple Example
Same race… different movement of time.
Imagine two toy cars moving in a playground.
One toy car moves on smooth flat ground.
Another toy car moves inside a deep spinning bowl.
The car on flat ground moves normally.
But the car inside the bowl keeps curving downward because the surface itself is bent.
Even though both cars are moving,
their paths become completely different because the shape beneath them is different.
The universe behaves in a similar way.
Near huge mass:
space bends more,
objects move differently,
and even time behaves differently.
That is why science says:
the faster something moves,
or the closer it goes to huge mass,
the more differently it experiences time.
The Biggest Mystery Of Time
Could time itself be flowing differently for different beings?
We usually think:
1 minute is same for everyone,
1 hour is same for everyone,
and time moves equally for all people.
But modern science says something very surprising:
Time can move differently for different people.
That means:
space can bend,
time can bend,
speed can affect time,
and huge mass can slow time down.
So two people can live in the same universe…
but still experience time differently.
The Two Hidden Forces That Secretly Control Time
Is time truly constant… or is something silently stretching and compressing it around us?
Mass and speed both affect the flow of time.
Science says time mainly changes in two ways:
1. Huge Mass
Objects like:
the Sun,
neutron stars,
and black holes
have enormous mass.
The greater the mass,
the more space and time bend around them.
That is why time behaves differently near extremely massive objects.
2. Speed
Now look at this simple formula:
s=dts=\frac{d}{t}s=td​
Where:
s = speed
d = distance
t = time
This formula shows that speed and time are connected.
Modern physics says:
when something moves extremely close to the speed of light,
its experience of time changes.
The faster something moves,
the slower time passes for it compared to others.
A Hidden Connection Between Mass, Speed, And Energy
What mysterious truth made scientists realize that motion, matter, and energy are all secretly connected?
Einstein explained this through the famous equation:
E=mc2E=mc^2E=mc2
Where:
E = energy
m = mass
c = speed of light
Now notice something important:
The speed term is squared.
That means:
even a small increase in speed creates a huge increase in energy.
So this equation tells us:
more mass → more energy,
more speed → enormously more energy.
And because mass and speed affect time,
time also starts behaving differently.
The Tiny Pin Mystery
How a tiny object can become extremely powerful.
Imagine a tiny 1-gram pin lying on a table.
Normally:
it looks harmless,
light,
and weak.
But now imagine that same pin moving at an extremely high speed.
Suddenly:
it can pierce metal,
create explosive impact,
and become incredibly powerful.
Why?
Because high speed creates enormous energy.
Modern physics says:
the pin’s normal mass does not literally become bigger,
but its energy becomes so huge that it behaves as if it has much greater mass.
So in simple words:
slow object → small effect,
extremely fast object → massive effect.
And since huge mass affects time,
extreme speed also changes the experience of time.
The Train That Experiences Less Time
Even on the same Earth, two people may silently experience completely different flows of time.
Note:In this example train is moving very fast somewhat equivalent to speed of light
Now imagine a futuristic train moving around Earth at an extremely high speed.
Suppose:
a person inside the train experiences only 5 minutes,
but outside the train, 10 minutes have already passed.
If he stays longer:
12 hours for him
may become 24 hours for people outside.
This scientific effect is called:
Time Dilation
When time moves differently for different people.
In simple words:
the faster something moves,
the slower time passes for it compared to others.
So even though both people are alive at the same moment,
their experience of time becomes different.
This Is Already Happening In Reality
Time dilation is real science, not imagination.
Scientists have already observed this effect.
For example:
satellites moving around Earth,
astronauts in space,
and tiny particles in laboratories
all experience small differences in time.
Even GPS satellites must constantly correct these tiny time changes.
Otherwise:
maps,
navigation,
and GPS systems
would stop working properly.
So the mystery is:
Time is not completely fixed.
It changes with speed, motion, and mass.
The Hidden Science Of Mantra Energy
Can vibration, speed, and spiritual energy change the experience of time?
Science explains through:
E=mc2E=mc^2E=mc2
that energy, mass, and speed are deeply connected.
The faster something moves,
the more powerful its energy becomes.
Now let’s connect this with mantra.
The Invisible Power Of Mantra
What really happens when mantra vibration becomes faster and deeper?
In spirituality,
mantra is not considered just sound.
Every mantra creates vibration.
When a saint chants continuously:
• with focus,
• with deep concentration,
• and with increasing speed,
the energy around him becomes stronger and stronger.
Just like:
• a slowly spinning fan creates little force,
• but a fast-moving fan creates powerful air movement,
in the same way,
faster mantra chanting creates a stronger spiritual energy field.
Ancient saints understood this as a real process of the astral world — long before modern science began exploring vibration and energy deeply.
The Secret Of The Astral Body
If the physical body does not change… then what actually becomes powerful?
According to spiritual knowledge,
the increase does not happen in the physical body.
It happens in the:
Sukshma Sharir — the astral body.
Meaning:
• faster mantra vibration creates stronger subtle energy,
• and stronger subtle energy increases subtle mass in the astral body.
As this subtle mass increases:
• the aura becomes stronger,
• Kundalini Shakti rises,
• and the saint’s spiritual force becomes more powerful.
This is why mantra chanting is not seen as ordinary words.
It is understood as:
• vibration,
• energy,
• force,
• and a way to influence consciousness and the experience of time itself.
The Invisible Train Around A Saint
Some saints may remain in the same world… yet experience the flow of time very differently.
We already understood how:
• faster movement can change the experience of time,
• and how mantra vibration increases the subtle mass of the astral body.
Now connect both ideas together.
As a saint chants mantras continuously with intense speed and concentration,
the astral body becomes more powerful and dense.
And just like the person inside the fast train experienced time differently,
the saint also starts experiencing time differently through the power of mantra vibration.
That is why ancient saints could:
• remain in samadhi for years,
• meditate for extremely long periods,
• survive with very little food,
• and still remain conscious and peaceful.
Because their experience of time was no longer functioning in the ordinary way.
The Secret Of Divine Speed
Can spiritual speed become so great that presence itself starts feeling limitless?
This is also connected to why Lord Hanuman Ji is called omnipresent.
His movement is understood as so incredibly fast that he can travel between places within tiny fractions of a second.
Not only this,
according to astral knowledge,
he also possesses multiple astral bodies whose speed is equally immense.
Because of this,
his presence can be experienced at many places almost simultaneously.
The transition happens so quickly that ordinary people cannot even notice it.
That is why divine beings are often described as appearing at multiple places almost instantly —
because their movement operates beyond normal human experience of time and motion.
The Hidden Stretch Of Time
Life may not stop death… yet the experience of living can still become longer.
According to this understanding,
death is not completely removed —
but the experience of time can change.
When a person enters a very deep spiritual state:
• body activity becomes slower,
• inner experience changes,
• and time starts feeling stretched.
It is like two clocks:
• one moving normally,
• another moving more slowly.
The slower clock takes longer to complete the same movement.
In the same way,
when the effect of time slows around a person,
the experience of life becomes longer for him.
That is why ancient saints were described as:
• staying in deep meditation for years,
• surviving in intense spiritual states,
• and experiencing time differently from ordinary people.
The Clock That Changes With Direction
Why does the same journey sometimes feel longer… and sometimes shorter?
We already understood that real time slowing happens only near extremely high speeds — almost close to the speed of light.
Airplanes are fast,
but not fast enough to create huge time dilation.
So then why does time still feel different during flights between India and Dubai?
The reason is:
• Earth’s rotation,
• changing time zones,
• and direction of travel.
When The Day Feels Longer
Can traveling make it feel like extra time appeared?
Suppose someone leaves India at 4 PM
and travels for 4 hours to Dubai.
Even after truly living 4 hours,
the Dubai clock shows only 6:30 PM because Dubai is behind India in time.
So it suddenly feels:
• as if less time passed,
• and the day became longer.
When Time Suddenly Feels Shorter
Can a journey make part of the day disappear?
Now imagine the same person traveling from Dubai to India.
Suppose:
• he leaves Dubai at 7:00 AM,
• and the flight takes 4 hours.
After landing in India,
the clock already shows 12:30 PM because India is ahead in time.
So even though he truly lived only 4 hours during the journey,
the day outside moved ahead much faster.
Because of this:
• less time of the day now remains for him,
• and it feels as if part of the day disappeared.
That is why the day suddenly feels shorter for the traveler.
The Deeper Reality Of Time
Can two people experience the same journey differently?
In both journeys:
• the airplane speed is almost the same,
• but the experience of time feels completely different.
Why?
Because time is connected not only to speed,
but also to:
• direction,
• motion,
• and position on Earth.
That is why:
sometimes time feels stretched,
sometimes compressed,
even inside the same journey.
When Time Moved Differently In Ayodhya
Was it really possible that one single day became one whole month?
Ancient scriptures describe a deeply mysterious moment during the birth of Lord Rama.
It is said that when Lord Rama took birth in Ayodhya,
the entire atmosphere became filled with immense divine mantra energy.
Deities were continuously chanting powerful mantras,
and because of that intense spiritual vibration:
• time inside Ayodhya started feeling slower,
• moments became deeper,
• and one single day there felt like one month for people outside.
Now the mysterious question is:
“If one day became one month, then did the Sun stop moving in the sky?”
The answer is — no.
The Sun continued moving normally.
Day and night continued normally for the outside world.
What changed was not the movement of the Sun,
but the experience of time inside that divine spiritual aura.
Just like in the fast train example:
• the person inside the train experiences time differently,
• while people outside experience normal time.
In the same way:
• Ayodhya became a powerful spiritual field,
• and time inside that space moved differently compared to the outside world.
So when the divine gathering ended and the deities departed,
people realized that while only one day was experienced in Ayodhya,
almost one month had passed outside.
And this leaves behind a mysterious thought:
Maybe time does not flow equally everywhere in the universe.
The Mystery Beyond Human Time
For divine beings, even a small moment may contain an entirely different experience of time.
Ancient scriptures describe something extremely mysterious:
• One blink of Lord Brahma covers thousands of years.
• One blink of Lord Shiva covers many Brahmas.
How can such a thing even be possible?
The deeper idea hidden inside these scriptures is that divine beings possess extremely powerful mantra shakti and an enormously vast astral body (Sukshma Sharir).
According to this understanding:
• stronger mantra vibrations create tremendous astral energy,
• tremendous astral energy increases the subtle mass of the astral body,
• and greater subtle mass makes time move very slowly for them.
That is why:
• for ordinary humans, time feels normal,
• but for higher divine beings, even a tiny moment may contain enormous stretches of time.
For humans:
• moments pass one after another.
But for divine consciousness:
• a single blink may cover ages,
• because their experience of time becomes completely different.
This is why ancient wisdom repeatedly points toward one mysterious truth:
Time is not experienced equally everywhere in the universe.
The Echo Of Lost Moments
Life may bring similar moments again… but never the exact same reality twice.
According to this understanding,
you may experience similar moments again,
but the original moment can never truly return.
You can:
• visit the same place again,
• drink tea again,
• watch another sunset again,
• or meet people who remind you of old memories.
But:
• the same people,
• the same emotions,
• and the same exact moment
can never come back exactly as before.
Because time has already moved ahead.
A simple example:
Suppose every evening at 5 PM,
you drink tea with your friends.
Next year,
you can again sit at 5 PM and drink tea.
The scene may feel similar,
but something will still be different:
• people may change,
• the place may change,
• and even you are no longer the same person.
So the pattern repeats,
but the exact past never returns.
The Time That Cannot Be Held
If time keeps moving forward… can any moment ever truly stay forever?
Earlier, we discussed the journey between India and Dubai.
Sometimes it feels:
• as if extra time was gained,
• and sometimes as if part of the day disappeared.
But in both situations,
time itself never stopped.
Only the experience changed.
This is the mystery of time:
• moments can feel familiar,
• experiences can repeat,
• but reality never returns in exactly the same form again.
The Silent Truth Of Time
Why do even divine beings value moments so deeply?
According to this understanding,
even divine beings are connected to the flow of time.
That is why scriptures speak about:
• rebirth,
• new incarnations,
• and repeating cycles of life.
Not about bringing back the exact same past.
This is why deities take rebirth again and again —
to relive love, relationships, and experiences with the souls they are connected to.
And in the same way,
negative astral entities also try to stay connected with people,
because they still wish to relive:
• old desires,
• old emotions,
• and moments they once experienced while alive.
The deeper message hidden in this knowledge is very emotional:
The people around us,
the moments we live,
and the experiences we share
are precious because they cannot return in exactly the same way again.
That is why every moment matters.
Because time keeps moving forward… for everyone.
The Invisible Energy Field Of Ashaeiynn
In a space filled with powerful mantra vibrations, even the experience of life may begin to change.
As we understood earlier,
powerful mantra chanting strengthens the astral body and its subtle energy.
The deeper understanding of Ashaeiynn is based on this same principle.
In Ashaeiynn,
continuous mantra chanting by:
• people,
• saints,
• and even divine entities
creates a very powerful spiritual field.
According to this knowledge,
this strong vibration affects the body’s inner experience of time,
which is why many people there begin feeling:
• lighter,
• calmer,
• emotionally healed,
• and spiritually stronger.
The idea is not based on magic,
but on:
• mantra vibration,
• astral energy,
• consciousness,
• and the changing experience of time through spiritual force.
The Mystery Of Pitrs And Astral Liberation
Can mantra vibration help trapped energies move forward?
As explained earlier,
mantra energy affects astral existence differently.
According to this concept,
some pitrs or negative astral entities remain trapped because their karmic cycle or remaining time is incomplete.
So during intense mantra chanting,
they are brought into that powerful spiritual field.
For living people,
the process slows the effect of time.
But for trapped astral entities,
their remaining astral cycle gets completed faster,
helping them move out of that yoni and continue their journey forward.
The Real Work Happening Inside Ashaeiynn
Is spiritual attraction connected to the power of the astral body?
The core understanding is simple:
• mantra creates vibration,
• vibration strengthens astral energy,
• astral energy increases subtle mass,
• and stronger subtle mass influences the experience of time.
As the astral body becomes stronger,
its presence naturally starts attracting people energetically.
That is why the connection people feel in Ashaeiynn is understood not only as emotional —
but also as spiritual and energetic.
